decision_vocabulary.status_not_outcome: OPEN (row 38): unresolved evidence is reported with the next discriminating test
decision_vocabulary.net_benefit_form: hard gates + Pareto (delta Xe, delta P_bus, delta mass, T/P_bus, restart and life burden vs C1); no weighted scalar unless preregistered (row 37); A9.1 HIQ-05: no mandatory Pareto relation - hard gates alone decide feasibility; the Pareto quantities are reported for engineering comparison unless a Pareto condition is preregistered at LOCK-1

what_this_is_not: not a performance prediction for H-1, C1 or the A9 ICP module; no Hall closure (credible set EMPTY), no abep_sim/plasma_devices.py, no withdrawn v1.2-v1.6 number
not a supply of the frozen v2 inputs; no ASSUMED_SCREENING_VALUE manufactured (row 146)
not a numeric threshold: margins, effect sizes, stop rules and n are frozen at LOCK-1 (rules) / LOCK-2 (values); the only numbers are owner-given (cited by row)

not a stage map (A9-01), bus boundary (A9-02), ICD (A9-03) or uncertainty budget (A9-04): those are separate deliverables (docs/experiments/hall_icp/prereg_framework/hall_icp_prereg_framework_v1.json; abep_sim/bus_boundary_a9.py + docs/architecture_comparison/power_boundary_a9/bus_power_boundary_a9_v1.json; schemas/interfaces/icp_neutralizer_icd_v1.json; docs/experiments/hall_icp/uncertainty_budget/hall_icp_uncertainty_budget_v1.json) referenced, never fabricated
Hall-closure uncertainty never leaks upstream: nothing here touches intake, compressor, gas chambers or valves models

evidence_steps.XCHK: module-exchange checks without plasma: cold/tare, service-line parasitic, B(z) perturbation, electrical isolation, RF pickup (row 64)

evidence_steps.AO: separate dedicated atomic-O materials/life programme (A9, row 132)

open_owner_questions.question: Which gas sustains the ICP neutralizer and where is it booked: (a) Hall exhaust re-use only (anchor topology), (b) dedicated Xe feed booked in the Xe ledger, (c) dedicated atmospheric feed?
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: carry (a) as the A9 first-build hypothesis with a capped dedicated-feed port for (b)/(c) so the comparison can measure whether a dedicated feed is needed; book any dedicated flow as PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW; final booking is an owner call
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: HIQ-06: primary ICP gas mode G-REUSE (Hall exhaust/residual); dedicated ICP port installed and capped; G-ATM / G-XE are declared contingency variants; score-bearing N2/N2+O2 uses G-REUSE unless it fails the preregistered ICP-capacity gate; no dedicated Xe to make the ICP work

open_owner_questions.question: Form of the neutralization margin (VI-EX-07)
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: electron-current capacity at the registered coupling-voltage limit divided by the measured Hall I_d at the same point, per configuration; form frozen at LOCK-1, numeric margin at LOCK-2 (rows 18, 19); owner call
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: UBQ-02: M_n = I_e,cap / I_d,dem - 1; gate on one-sided lower confidence bound > 0; any extra design margin frozen at LOCK-2 per LOCK-1 rule
